# StudLoans

> Student loan guidance platform helping borrowers compare repayment plans, check forgiveness eligibility, and optimize their payoff strategy

## About

StudLoans is a free student loans, repayment plans & loan forgiveness platform at [studloans.com](https://studloans.com). Founded in 2024.

- Free repayment plan comparison tools
- Up-to-date with latest federal loan policy changes
- Trusted by borrowers navigating student debt
- Independent guidance with no lender affiliations

## Tools & Calculators

- [Student Loan Calculator](https://studloans.com/student-loan-calculator): Calculate monthly payments and total cost
- [Repayment Plan Comparison](https://studloans.com/repayment-comparison): Compare all federal repayment plans side by side
- [PSLF Eligibility Checker](https://studloans.com/pslf-checker): Check if you qualify for Public Service Loan Forgiveness
- [Refinance Calculator](https://studloans.com/refinance-calculator): See if refinancing saves you money
- [Loan Payoff Planner](https://studloans.com/payoff-planner): Create a customized payoff strategy
